g.text: on Influenza A virus (IAV) and RSV concentration
at WWTPs in California, Colorado, and Florida.
Assumptions in using and aggregating the data
Same epidemic level and wastewater level across
Detection rate on a give day is calculated for each region
The number of positive samples at all WWTPs
The number of analyzed samples at all WWTPs
Wastewater concentration for each region is calculated, using
weighted averaging (If all samples are detected).
